lines: <pulse>Back</pulse> to finding a small task I can finish properly.
I should look around and lend a hand where I can.
There are always chores worth doing, even without being asked.
I will see if anyone needs help before evening.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to making today useful however I can.
That path still needs sweeping. I can manage that.
Someone left supplies in the square again. I should move them.
A neighbor was waiting for help when we started talking.
Daylight is running out, and so is my excuse to stand here.
I still have one errand to finish.
I should find the next useful thing before it finds me.
The square will not clean itself, despite years of waiting.
I promised to carry water before supper.
There is no trade in leaving work half done.
I can finish one more chore before dark.
Someone always needs a spare pair of hands.
I should check whether the meeting path is clear.
Talk is easy. I would rather leave something useful behind.
I have an empty hand and a full afternoon. That should be enough.
I will get back to it. Whatever it turns out to be.
